text:
Incident-Bot: PagerDuty PDR-9123 fired -> cuda OOM spikes on pool gpu-w-23 (us-west2). Alert: nvml OOM rate >5/min, affected nodes: gpu-w-23,gpu-w-24,gpu-w-25. Severity: CRITICAL.

Samir: acked, I'm on it.

Samir: quick context — noticed sudden prefetch/kvcache growth after midnight deploy. jumping into node logs and nvidia-smi.

Ops Bot: runbook ref https://internal/runbooks/gpu-oom (steps: check kvcache evictions, reduce batch_size, apply pool throttles, fallback routing).

Jin Park: metric spike aligns with model rollout v3-quant at 2025-08-12T01:58:00Z. kvcache size has +40% in last 10m. recommending rollback or throttle prefetch.

Samir: nvidia-smi snapshot from gpu-w-23:
```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| GPU  Name        Memory-Usage  |
| 0    A100        31989MiB / 40536MiB |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

Samir: tail /var/log/serving/gpu-driver.log shows repeated cudaMalloc failures: 
```
[2025-08-12T02:11:12Z] cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
[2025-08-12T02:11:13Z] kv_cache: growth detected, evictions not keeping up
[2025-08-12T02:11:15Z] cudaMalloc retry, timeout
```

Samir: applying emergency mitigations: 1) throttle pool concurrency to 2, 2) disable kvcache prefetch for pool gpu-w-23, 3) route heavy endpoints to fallback small-llama model.

PagerDuty: PDR-9123 acknowledged by Samir.

Jin Park: I'm rolling back v3-quant on a couple of nodes now, will watch memory pressure. Also patching autoscaler to lower max_batch_size for the affected route.

Samir: quick commands executed: `kubectl -n serving patch deploy pool-gpu-w-23 -p '{"spec":{"replicas":1}}'` and `redwoodctl pools throttle --pool gpu-w-23 --concurrency 2`

Ben: taking handoff (on-call rotation). please leave remaining items here — I'll monitor and coordinate infra for node-level reboot if required.

Samir: left runbook notes: disabled prefetch, restarted serving on nodes 23/24 (graceful drain). saw immediate reduction in cudaMalloc errors.

Ben: metrics look stable, OOM alerts dropped to 0 in last 5m. Confirmed customer impact: a brief ~2m window with elevated 502/timeouts for hosted API customers on that route. No Dedicated customers impacted.

Samir: thanks — I'll start a quick postmortem draft and tag customer-impact for comms. Ben, please keep the page open until 30m of no regressions.

Ben: will do. marking this as in-progress and handing off pager. :white_check_mark:

Incident-Bot: PDR-9123 -> status: acknowledged, owners: Ben, Samir.

(End of thread)
